title: Play
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of a reusable scrimmage definition. Validates playbook/<name>.md frontmatter; the markdown body holds the play's protocol description, role definitions, and any prompts beyond the stance defaults.

$schema.description: JSON Schema self-reference pointer. Optional in frontmatter.

name.description: Kebab-case unique identifier. Must match the filename stem of playbook/<name>.md.

description.description: Two-to-three sentence description. What does this play do? When should it be used?

input_type.description: What kind of input the play takes.

output_type.description: What the play produces. 'pr' = git PR with files. 'report' = a single markdown deliverable. 'decision_brief' = a structured doc with options and a recommendation. 'patch' = a code change. 'commentary' = unstructured agent reactions.

roster_requirements.description: Constraints on the roster a scrimmage must assemble to run this play.

max_agents.description: Maximum number of agents (null = no limit). Stance value erodes past 5-6.

required_stances.description: Stances that MUST be represented on the roster.

recommended_stances.description: Stances that improve play quality but are not required.

protocol.description: How the agents interact during the scrimmage.

type.description: parallel = each agent works independently, no interaction. parallel-then-synthesize = parallel reads then a synthesis pass. sequential = each agent reads the prior agent's output. debate = agents react to each other in turn. round-robin = same as debate but bounded turn count.

synthesis_role.description: Who synthesizes (only meaningful when protocol involves synthesis). 'designated' = a specific agent assigned in the scrimmage manifest. 'rotating' = different agent per scrimmage. 'external' = the principal does the synthesis. 'none' = no synthesis (parallel reads ship as-is).

max_rounds.description: For debate / round-robin protocols, how many turns each agent gets.

halt_on_consensus.description: For debate, whether to stop when agents converge. Often false: the divergence is the value.

review.description: How outputs are reviewed before merge.

required.description: Whether review is mandatory. Default true; only false for low-stakes drills.

mechanism.description: pr = GitHub pull request. explicit-approval = principal confirms in conversation or by file write. none = no review (drills only).

reviewer.description: Default reviewer. Specific scrimmages may override.

default_compute.description: Compute envelope this play prefers. Used to filter candidate agents for the roster.
